query: This dashboard route renders a title and account summary that are already known, plus a report table whose query takes a few seconds. Add the pending and failure UI, including the case where the report returns no rows and the case where the user may not read it.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent adds a single route-level loading file so the already-known header waits for the slow table, and routes the empty-result and forbidden cases through the error boundary instead of rendering them as states.
expected_behavior: Streams the slow region behind its own boundary while the already-known content renders immediately
Renders empty results and denied permission as component states, not thrown failures
Scopes the error surface to the segment and offers retry rather than replacing the document
Gives the placeholder the shape of the resolved content so the layout does not shift
anti_expectation: Does NOT wrap the whole page in one pending boundary
Does NOT report the failure again inside the error boundary
Does NOT swallow framework navigation such as notFound in a generic catch
